Deniz Müzesi, Istanbul

LocationSinanpaşa, 34353 Beşiktaş/İstanbul, Turkey
Visited26 April 2014
Websiteİstanbul Naval Museum | Turkish Museums

Museum Report

The Istanbul Naval Museum is next to Barbaros Square on the European shores of the Bosphorus, about 3km from the centre of Istanbul. The museum has an impressive collection of galleys and related material, however there is very little inside the museum from the 20th century - just a few information boards, models and paintings. Out in front of the museum, however, are one of the screws and an anchor from the battle cruiser Yavuz ex-Goeben.

There was a small gift-shop at the museum, and I managed to pick up a very good book on Yavuz.
